prediction_unit: drug moiety x dose x duration x species/model x endpoint

label_policy.decreased: reported inhibition direction, not automatically noncytotoxic

candidate_scope: marketed FDA names for deployment; discontinued controls retained separately for retrospective evaluation
feature_source_mask: all seven pilot outcome papers and aliases; matching target mechanism references also removed
split: leave one connected compound/parent/scaffold/paper group out; current pilot only
gnn_status: deferred until label diversity and grouped sample size justify comparison with simple baselines
tuning: within development groups only; no fitting imputation/scalers/calibration on held-out groups
metrics: precision at laboratory screening budget on complete tested panels
prospective_noncytotoxic_thresholds: must be specified with the lab before collecting the locked prospective screen; retrospective qualitative labels are not threshold-equivalent
final_test: future separately acquired compound/scaffold/time-separated assay panel; not this inspected development pilot
